identifiability_constraints.usable_result: Direction-specific joint busy-time response vs source programs/owner
identifiability_constraints.why: Programs, three scalar metadata loads and fixed 512B payload are collinear. Compiled descriptor count, grid assignment and exporter owner aggregation remain separate conditions.
identifiability_constraints.needed_contrast: Hold bytes constant while changing descriptors, then hold descriptors constant while changing bytes; retain exact compiled instruction counts and PMU aggregation metadata.

identifiability_constraints.usable_result: Complete INT32/BF16 native ABI and scalar busy at three capacity domains, with a source scan of 64 group descriptors per launched block
identifiability_constraints.why: The group scan count stays 64 while valid work, tile control and scalar address work vary. A scalar-time/GetValue quotient includes these other operations.
identifiability_constraints.needed_contrast: Vary stored group count at fixed valid rows, layouts, tile schedule and BlockNum; retain actual group-list values and generated scalar instructions.

identifiability_constraints.usable_result: Full mean/P50 PMU populations with conditional sort-block, SIMT-read and owner-zero E288 counts
identifiability_constraints.why: Owner-zero GetValue remains E288 and sort/SIMT/quantization coexist in one kernel. Scalar wait is not exported; sort blocks are not compiled sort instruction counts.
identifiability_constraints.needed_contrast: Hold assignments/width constant while varying E, and separately vary assignments with the same sort branch; retain route values, SIMT atomic/cache events and owner-specific counters.
